items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And Bob Aguilar on the piano. ... So, so, so, but...so I took over on the piano.

ctx.x: Did you have any jokes? Do you remember?

Yeah, a lot of jokes and all we had. I mean, I don't remember them all. I mean, it was... Taiwan, no more. Yeah, then, uh... We had a marching band up around the end of the concert. We'd see boys through the park and all the crowd would follow us, you know? Yeah. Something like the Saints or High Society. It was a lot of fun. I learned a lot out there, too. Some people would dance and all? Yeah, they're dancing there, you know, listening and everything else. And then we had some dance music and some marches and…
And he'd just get all frustrated. Can you still buy another five read? Do they still make them that hard?
